title: incident-bot: oncall SLO autodx - contextual SLO hints and runbook linking
author: Leah Thompson
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot on-call diagnostics by surfacing contextual SLO hints, improving runbook linking heuristics, and adding telemetry to track suggestion acceptance rates. Backwards-compatible; no user-facing API changes.
description: Context: on-call engineers frequently need immediate SLO context (recent burn, alerting thresholds, and owner info) when incident-bot surfaces diagnostics. This PR adds contextual SLO hints to the on-call messages and improves runbook auto-linking by scoring candidate runbooks using SLO tags and recent incident similarity. Changes: 1) Add SLO hint generator that aggregates recent SLO burn, alert thresholds, and owner contacts (service+team) and renders a compact hint block. 2) Improve runbook-linking matcher: feature flags for fuzzy match weighting, include SLO tags in scoring, and prioritize runbooks used in last 30 days. 3) Telemetry: new metrics incident_bot.slo_hint_shown, incident_bot.runbook_suggested, incident_bot.runbook_accepted to measure utility. 4) Add configuration knobs and rollout flag (ff: slo-autodx-hints) for gradual ramp. Testing and rollout: unit tests for scoring, integration tests for message formatting, manual canary enabled via feature flag for 10% of teams, monitor metrics dashboard for acceptance rate and false-positive links. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout - [x] Docs updated (internal runbook) - [x] Telemetry dashboards prepared Notes: kept runbook scoring lightweight to avoid N+1s; SLO aggregation uses cached windowed queries and falls back to summary when unavailable. Related: ENG-2312, SRE-114, SUP-8421.
commits: feat: add SLO hint generator and templated hint block
feat: include SLO tags in runbook-linking matcher and add fuzzy weight config
perf: cache SLO windowed aggregates to reduce DB pressure
test: unit+integration tests for hint formatting and matcher
chore: add telemetry metrics and Grafana dashboard scaffolding
docs: internal runbook notes and rollout playbook
review_comments: Jorge Alvarez: Great direction. Two requests: make the runbook matcher threshold configurable and add a circuit-breaker if acceptance rate < 1% during canary.
Leah Thompson: Thanks Jorge - added a feature-flagged threshold and a canary health check that disables suggestions if acceptance < 2% over 30m. See feature_flags and telemetry hooks.
Mina Park: Small nit - prefer to avoid blocking DB calls in the formatter path. Can the aggregator fall back to a lightweight summary from cache?
Leah Thompson: Agreed. Implemented cached windowed aggregates with fast fallback summary; added bench and docs in pkg/cache.
Riley Chen: CI flake on integration test on first run (timeout). After increasing test timeout + retry the pipeline passed. Approving now.
Mina Park: Approved - behavior looks safe behind flag and telemetry is sufficient to rollback if needed.
ci_summary: Initial CI: failed integration test due to timeout; after increasing test timeout and adding a retry the full suite passed. Linting: clean. Coverage: unchanged (small logic added but tests cover the main paths).
post_merge_actions:
- Turn on slo-autodx-hints for 10% canary group via feature flag
- Monitor incident_bot.runbook_accepted and slo_hint_shown dashboards
- If acceptance <2% or false-link rate >5% over 1h, rollback flag
- In one week, expand to 50% and then 100% pending metric signals
notes: Kept algorithm conservative: only suggest runbooks with score > 0.6 and at least one exact tag match. Telemetry instruments both shown and accepted events to measure precision. No breaking changes to public APIs.
changelog_entry: Add contextual SLO hints and improved runbook linking for incident-bot (feature-flagged; rollout/canary).
security_considerations: SLO owner contacts are included in on-call messages only when team-level consent exists; sanitized to avoid exposing PII. Access control unchanged.
qa_instructions: Enable slo-autodx-hints feature flag for a test team, trigger synthetic SLO burn, run incident-bot local harness, verify hint block appears and suggested runbooks include expected tag matches. Check metrics emitted to telemetry-staging.
